ch.epfl.biop.imaris

Class EasyXT.Dataset

  • java.lang.Object
    • ch.epfl.biop.imaris.EasyXT.Dataset
  • Enclosing class:
    EasyXT

    public static class EasyXT.Dataset
extends Object
    This sublass deals with direct Imaris Datasets, not surface-based datasets This includes methods to transfer, convert and move datasets around Imaris and Fiji

      • addChannels

        public static void addChannels(ij.ImagePlus imp)
                        throws Imaris.Error
        Adds the selected ImagePlus to the current Dataset by appending it as new channels. To speed things up, but with a higher memory footprint, we first clone the dataset and append the channels. Finally we replace the current dataset with the new one This avoids the Imaris GUI refreshing as the dataset is being modified, which is very slow
        Parameters:
        imp - the image to add to the current dataset
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error object

      • addChannels

        public static void addChannels(ij.ImagePlus imp,
                               Imaris.IDataSetPrx dataset,
                               int xStart,
                               int yStart,
                               int zStart,
                               int tStart)
                        throws Imaris.Error

        Adds the selected ImagePlus to the provided IDatasetPrx by appending each channel of the ImagePlus as new channels into the provided IDataSetPrx, at a given starting location in XYCZT

        Sanity checks performed:

        • Ensure ImagePlus dimensions are not larger than the provided dataset dimensions (including provided starting locations). Throws an Error if larger than the dataset.
        • Ensure consistent bit-depth between ImagePlus and IDataSetPrx. throws Error if otherwise
        • Ensure consistent voxel size (ignore framerate) between ImagePlus and Dataset. Issues warning if otherwise
        The user can define the start location XYZT in pixel coordinates.
        Parameters:
        imp - the image from which to extract the channels to append
        dataset - the receiver dataset
        xStart - start X position, in pixels (from top-left in ImageJ, will translate to bottom-left in Imaris)
        yStart - start Y position, in pixels (from top-left in ImageJ, will translate to bottom-left in Imaris)
        zStart - start Z position, in pixels (Z=0 is the top slice in Image, will translate to bottom slice in Imaris)
        tStart - start T position, in pixels (from top-left in ImageJ, will translate to bottom-left in Imaris)
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error Object

      • removeChannels

        public static void removeChannels(int... channelIndices)
                           throws Imaris.Error
        Removes the selected channels from the current Dataset. Mirrors addChannels(ImagePlus). To avoid slow Imaris GUI refreshes, we clone the dataset, remove the channels from the clone, then replace the current dataset.
        Parameters:
        channelIndices - 0-based channel indices to remove. Order does not matter, duplicates are ignored.
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error object

      • removeChannels

        public static void removeChannels(Imaris.IDataSetPrx dataset,
                                  int... channelIndices)
                           throws Imaris.Error

        Removes the selected channels from the provided IDataSetPrx in place, by shifting the kept channels down and shrinking the channel count. The Imaris API (10.0) has no native "remove channel" call, so we copy data and per-channel metadata (color, name, description, range, gamma, color table) for each channel that shifts.

        Parameters:
        dataset - the dataset to modify in place
        channelIndices - 0-based channel indices to remove. Order does not matter, duplicates are ignored.
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error object
